note_order: normal/reversed changes painting and refusal priority but is absent from readout text, so both choices deduplicate to one readout per underlying numeric tuple.
deduplication_proof: For each fixed camera, native integer mid and far offsets produce61 distinct formatted strings apiece, verified by explicit finite sets.
Camera itself appears as a delimited token, so different camera groups cannot collide even if one scene coordinate agrees.
The three phases have distinct target-camera tokens (-12,0,12), so phase groups cannot collide.
For every camera, actual frame output has reachable fore0 blocked and fore30 clear; all other fore values collapse to the same two suffixes without changing mid/far/camera tokens.
The three language templates preserve these delimiter-separated tokens. No camera/mid/far correlation is discarded.
